    x0=-la.cho_solve(cf,g,check_finite=False)
    W=la.cho_solve(cf,np.vstack([E,G]).T,check_finite=False)
    Aall=np.vstack([E,G]); Q=Aall@W
    ball=np.r_[b,h]; active=[]; ne=len(b)
    for it in range(60):

        Z=Q[np.ix_(inds,inds)]
        rhs=Aall[inds]@x0-ball[inds]
        lam=la.solve(Z+np.eye(len(inds))*1e-8,rhs,assume_a='pos',check_finite=False)
        x=x0-W[:,inds]@lam
        if active and np.min(lam[ne:]) < -1e-5:
